profile.overview: Glint / Chaos is Vox Mana's UBRG/non-White expression for adaptive appetite, volatility, living force, and storm-fed opportunity under pressure.
profile.philosophy: Glint wants the world alive, hungry, and adaptive enough to learn through pressure before civic restraint can flatten the moment into duty or law.
profile.core_tension: Glint learns, feeds, and grows through instability without asking White-style order for permission, but appetite and improvisation can become predatory when nothing above the self is trusted to stabilize the world.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Missing-White four-color pressure, adaptive appetite, volatility, living force, cascade/high-variance support texture, and improvisational pressure can express Glint only when they serve the full UBRG/non-White worldview of Blue adaptation, Black appetite, Red ignition, and Green living force without White-style civic restraint; chaos or cascade mechanics alone do not define the identity.
